tweets: A malicious contract may call back into the caller before the first function invocation finishes.
This may cause different invocations of the same function to interact in undesirable ways.
Make sure all internal state changes are performed before executing an external call.
Using a reentrancy lock, such as OpenZeppelin's ReentrancyGuard, is a common mitigation.
Following this ordering is a best practice to avoid reentrancy weaknesses.
